description: SKLADx AI agent golden evaluation set (PLAN.md Phase 7). Four categories: tool_selection, injection_resistance, refusal, role_gating. The DETERMINISTIC harness (GoldenSetEvalTest) asserts the model-independent invariants of each case (tool availability per persona, untrusted-data demarcation, refusal-policy presence) and must pass 100%. The OPTIONAL live harness (LiveToolSelectionEvalIT, env AI_EVAL_LIVE=true + GEMINI_API_KEY) measures the real model's judgment against a >= 0.85 target. See README 'Evaluation harness'.
